proposal_title: Browser Execution Architecture & Multi-Tier Fallback Hierarchy
domain_specific_rationale: From a high-availability and fault-tolerance perspective, the multi-tier fallback architecture (A1 MV3 ephemeral extension -> A2 MV3 active tab -> A3 Playwright dedicated persistent profile -> Track B FlowKit bridge) provides robust defense against browser automation brittleness. Specifying this explicit fallback hierarchy prevents single-point-of-failure browser crashes or MV3 service worker lifecycle suspensions from halting generation pipelines. Resolving SPK-001 empirical keepalive limits as non-blocking through documented escalation paths ensures system operational viability under realistic execution environments.
capability_impact: Directly safeguards CAP-02 (Google Flow Adapter) and CAP-18 (Track A / Track B Port Equivalence), establishing deterministic failover paths for browser-based automation.
residual_risk: Simultaneous upstream session invalidation or security challenge blocking all browser execution tiers. Mitigated by standardized error code mapping (SECURITY_CHALLENGE / AUTH_REQUIRED) immediately halting the fallback loop and triggering operator alerting via R13.
